Composição calcula todas as tuas mãos se: Composition calculates all your hands without replacing cards, sharing balance and splits. It requires an empty start at a table created here or an observed shuffle. Validated AI rejects worse proposals in the approximate calculation; Compare plays the table. Experimental AI uses the model proposal, falling back to the table on failure. Calculations stay on this Mac; login and balance are not sent to the model.
Composição usa apenas cartas reveladas,: Composition uses only revealed cards from a tracked start and falls back to the table if information or time is missing. Local AI and composition are experimental. No mode predicts hidden cards or guarantees winnings.
Confirma o processamento em segundo plan: Checks background processing using synthetic cards. No requests are sent to the site and no accounts are changed.
